newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Bros posts first half net profit.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Bros posts first half net profit.

text.p: Britain's Marks & Spencer plc said on Tuesday its Brooks Brothers unit had operating profits of $1.7 million in the first half of the year ending September 30, versus a $4 million loss in the same period last year.
Store sales, including operations in Japan, increased to $218 million from $198 million in the first half last year, the company said.

"Customers are responding to Brooks Brothers' updated merchandise, improved customer service and more consistent availability of merchandise," said Brooks Brothers President and Chief Executive Officer Joseph Gromek.
He said the subsidiary was on the right track for the future but it still had a long way to go.

Marks & Spencer reported an 11 percent increase in first half pre-tax profits to 430.1 million pounds on Tuesday, but its shares fell as retail analysts in the UK said profits were 20 to 30 million pounds lower than expected.
